description: Scans a local repository and appends a simple product workflow diagram to a tldraw board. Use this when the user asks Codex to draw what a project does.

boardName.description: Board name under the target repository boards directory. Defaults to "main".

repoPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

name: diagram_repo
title: Diagram product workflow
